request.style: English, orchestral, female solo voice with ethereal choir, harp, strings, flute, piano, cello, serene and majestic, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The craftsman speaks to the goldsmith
The hammer urges the striker
He says the solder is good
And fastens the idol tight
It will not topple down
But you are my servant chosen
Jacob, offspring of Abraham
My friend in the ends of the earth

[Pre-Chorus]
I called you from farthest corners
I said you are my servant
I have chosen you now
And have not rejected you

[Chorus]
Do not fear for I am with you
Do not be dismayed I am your God
I will strengthen you surely
I will help you uphold you
With my righteous right hand
I am holding you fast

[Verse]
All who rage against you
Will be put to shame and disgraced
Those who oppose you now
Will come to nothing perish
Look for your quarreling foes
And you will not find them
Those who made war on you
Are as nothing at all

[Chorus]
Do not fear for I am with you
Do not be dismayed I am your God
I will strengthen you surely
I will help you uphold you
With my righteous right hand
I am holding you fast

[Bridge]
I am the LORD your God
Who takes hold of your right hand
I say to you clearly
Do not fear I am your help

[Chorus]
Do not fear for I am with you
Do not be dismayed I am your God
I will strengthen you surely
I will help you uphold you
With my righteous right hand
I am holding you fast

[Outro]
Do not fear
I am with you
